notes.title: Friends leader board added
notes.notes:
As title of update says ive added friends leader board which can be found under the top 20 scores on the main menu. Its still early days so expect polishing. If you dont see any freinds there that will becuase you have no friends who have played snail racer since latest leaderboard reset.

Also with this update

-added the snail dollar display in the upgrade screen.
-Some other effects in game added.
-Startline added

notes.title: SNAIL RACER EXTREME update 7/11/2018
notes.notes: Massive changes have taken place making the game more fun and challenging. So today we bring dodging and collecting to snail racer rather then a dumb clicker . Hope all who purchase snail racer on release enjoy the game and future updates. We plan to add more levels and a high score system.
